answer_1.quote: We introduce Bayelemabaga, a new comprehensive dataset for machine translation that comprises 46,976 pairs of Bambara and French sentences.
answer_1.outputs: Bambara translations of French sentences and French translations of Bambara sentences

answer_2.quote: We compare the quality of different MT systems using widely-known n-gram matching evaluation metrics, SacreBLEU (BLEU) and CHRF++. We also use AfriCOMET, a learned COMET metric for MT covering 13 African languages.

answer_4.quote: We conducted a human evaluation using a sample of 100 translations from each of the seven models.
answer_4.guideline: We evaluated the quality of the translation as good or bad based on problems related to their fluency, adequacy, and understanding. We then introduced a score of one to five to rank all models' overall performance, allocating a score of five to the model that depicts the best quality with no problem.
